description_en: For example, inbound and outbound call properties and the associated IVR flow
description_zh: 比如内呼和外呼属性以及绑定的IVR流程
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-phone-number --instance-id d278629c-c687-4aa3-b044-4fe9b012e7ef --phone-number-id cc583e96-6bae-437e-9aeb-bffd5aeddb73 --usage Bidirection --contact-flow-id 8Cvg_0mcsm6 --skill-group-id example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPhoneNumber

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the phone number to modify
parameters.name: phone_number_id

parameters.help_en:
The usage of the phone number. Valid values:
Inbound: inbound calls only.
Outbound: outbound calls only.
Bidirection: both inbound and outbound calls
parameters.help_zh: 该电话号码的用途。取值：呼入（Inbound），呼出（Outbound），已经同时用于呼入和呼出（Bidirection）
parameters.name: usage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact flow associated with the phone number
parameters.help_zh: 和电话号码绑定的联系流ID
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the skill group associated with the phone number.

The parameter SkillGroupId.1 retrieves information about one skill group. To retrieve information about multiple skill groups, specify both SkillGroupId.1 and SkillGroupId.2
parameters.help_zh:
和电话号码绑定的技能组ID。


参数名称SkillGroupId.1表示只获取1个技能组信息。如果要获取多个技能组信息，则需要有SkillGroupId.1以及SkillGroupId.2
parameters.name: skill_group_id
